datasheet.source: Texas Instruments SBVS361B, revised May 2025 (local PDF)

symbol.unit: single functional unit; IN/EN left, OUT/NC right, ground pins down

mapping.9: EP/thermal pad, connected to GND per datasheet

symbol.nc_representation: Pins 2, 3, 4, 6 use no_connect pin type. Ground pin 5 and EP pad 9 are separate same-net power pins.
symbol.placement_update: Ground pins 5 and 9 moved to x=-5.08mm and +5.08mm; centered reference/value moved below both ground pins to avoid overlap. SVG re-exported successfully.

footprint.review: Adjusted perimeter pads to match TI DRB0008J example board land pattern: eight pads, 0.60 x 0.31 mm, 0.50 mm pitch, row span 2.80 mm; centered exposed metal pad 9, 1.60 x 2.00 mm. Four paste windows each 0.60 x 0.80 mm. Earlier pad width 0.25 mm was narrower than TI example 0.31 mm; footprint updated to 0.31 mm.

model.origin: Generic KiCad StepUp WSON-8-1EP_3x3mm_P0.5mm_EP1.6x2.0mm model, not TI-origin. FreeCAD 1.0.0 STEP import verified one solid with body bounds 3.00 x 2.98 x 0.82 mm and separate planar exposed-metal bottom face bounds 1.60 x 2.00 mm at z=0. Footprint project-relatively links it.

electrical_notes.dropout: Fixed-output DRB: 225 mV maximum at 150 mA (VOUT >= 3.3 V); a nominal 5 V input cannot guarantee 5 V output at load.
electrical_notes.output_capacitance: Recommended 2.2 to 220 uF nominal; effective capacitance >=1 uF required for stability; ESR 0.001 to 2 ohm. X5R/X7R preferred. Account for DC bias, tolerance, temperature and aging.
electrical_notes.input_capacitance: Not required for stability; typical recommendation 1 uF, min 0.1 uF; >=0.5 uF for robust EMI.

candidate_c5_review.active_bom_identity: C5 is Samsung CL31B475KBHNNNE, LCSC C51205; 4.7 uF, 50 V, X7R, 1206, +/-10% per BOM evidence. It is not Murata GRM31CR71H475KA12L/C97946.
candidate_c5_review.assessment: C5 nominal 4.7 uF is a plausible output-cap candidate, but current project evidence has no exact-part manufacturer bias/temperature curve or guaranteed minimum capacitance, so it cannot be said to guarantee >=1 uF effective at 5 V and operating temperature. Keep C5 unchanged until that minimum is substantiated. Datasheet recommends 2.2 uF or larger nominal.
